description: This file contains utility functions for map-related calculations, image processing, template parsing, and UI element creation within the Thingsboard project. It includes functions for coordinate calculations, image aspect ratio loading, template string parsing with dynamic data, and map boundary checks.

classes.name: ImageWithAspect
classes.description: Interface representing an image URL with its aspect ratio.

methods.name: getRatio
methods.description: Calculates the ratio of the intermediate moment between two moments.

methods.name: interpolateOnLineSegment
methods.description: Interpolates latitude and longitude between two points based on a ratio.

methods.name: findAngle
methods.description: Calculates the angle in degrees between two geographic points.

methods.name: getDefCenterPosition
methods.description: Parses a string or coordinate array to return a coordinate pair.

methods.name: loadImageWithAspect
methods.description: Loads an image and computes its aspect ratio, caching results.

methods.name: parseWithTranslation
methods.description: Object providing methods to translate and parse templates with optional translation function.

methods.name: functionValueCalculator
methods.description: Executes a function with parameters if enabled, otherwise returns a default value.

methods.name: calculateNewPointCoordinate
methods.description: Normalizes a coordinate value based on image size to a 0-1 range.

methods.name: createLoadingDiv
methods.description: Creates a styled loading overlay div with specified text.

methods.name: checkLngLat
methods.description: Clamps a geographic point within specified map bounds with optional offset.
